result:
A3 is complete and verified.

**What changed**

- **`lib/plan.ts`** (new) — `Plan` type, `normalizePlan(plan)` (missing/unknown → `"basic"`), `planFromPriceId(priceId, map)` (unmapped price → `"basic"`).
- **`lib/lesson-access.ts`** — new signature `canUseProLesson(plan, role, proEnabled = true)`: true only when `proEnabled` and (staff role, incl. legacy `pro_student`, or `normalizePlan(plan) === "premium"`).
- **`convex/lab.ts:123`** — the single caller now reads the `enrollments` row via `by_user_course` (`.unique()`, matching `courses.ts`/`study.ts`) and passes `enrollment?.plan`.
- **`convex/billing.ts`** — `syncStripeSubscription` gained `plan: v.optional(planTier)`, spread into the existing `enrollmentPatch` **only when present**, so a webhook that doesn't know the plan can't silently downgrade a Premium enrollment to Basic.
- **Tests** — `lib/plan.test.ts` (5) + rewritten `lib/lesson-access.test.ts` (5), covering all five cases the spec asked for plus the legacy-role and empty-map edges. I mutation-checked them: default-premium `normalizePlan`, dropped `proEnabled`, and dropped `pro_student` were each killed; all mutants reverted, diff clean.

**Verification:** `npx convex codegen` clean · `npm run lint` 0 errors (same 7 pre-existing warnings) · `npm run test` 24 files / 132 tests passing (was 23 / 124).

**Two things worth your attention in the morning** (both written up in `docs/STUDIO-PROGRESS.md`):

1. The D.4 bug is fixed in logic but not yet in practice — nothing writes `enrollments.plan` until A6 passes `plan` through from `metadata.planSlug`. I deliberately left `app/api/stripe/webhook/route.ts` untouched, since A6.md explicitly owns that and a price→plan map would need Stripe price IDs I'm not allowed to set. To test now, set `plan: "premium"` on your enrollment row in the Convex dashboard.
2. `lib/stripe.ts` currently puts only `courseId`, `courseSlug`, `userId` in `subscription_data.metadata`. `planSlug` has to be added there, or every renewal will reach A6 without a plan.

Nothing was committed — the runner script commits each step itself.
